title: Pilot: combat heard from the commander's cupola, buttoned up, a live T-34 at 150 m
caption: COMMANDER CUPOLA / BUTTONED UP - LIVE T-34 AT 150 M
input_audit: Arena bench: one live T-34 150 m straight ahead with ordinary detection, lay, discharge, swept flight and impact (no outcome selection). The commander closes his hatch at 0.2 s and stays buttoned up in the cupola; the Tiger drives 12-19 s. The two own-gun discharges (7 s, 27 s) are the disclosed staged_discharge fixture (the solo player fires only from the sight). Every sound is the calibration's physical level at the ear through the live Audio graph.
historical_scope: A sound-level demonstration on the training arena, not a historical engagement.
visual_acceptance: Buttoned in the cupola: the engine and tracks are the bed; the T-34's reports arrive as dull thumps through the hull; its strikes ring on the armour near the commander; the own 88 dominates.
